{
  "$schema": "https://json-schema.org/draft/2020-12/schema",
  "title": "Butter Crunch Game",
  "summary": "A clean, tactile single-stage interactive Roblox game featuring a butter object on a minimalist pedestal. Players on desktop or mobile click or tap the butter object (or an on-screen tap prompt) to initiate a satisfying crunch compression animation with synchronized Marketplace audio and particle/flake feedback. A persistent readable counter starts at 0 and increments by exactly 1 per completed crunch cycle, ignoring rapid spam inputs until the butter resets and recovers. When 10 separate crunches are completed, the counter clearly displays 10. The system features server validation, debounce protection against double-counting, smooth procedural/tweened restoration after each crunch, and no extraneous monetization or shops.",
  "visualDirection": "Minimalist, warm, and inviting kitchen/countertop aesthetic. A soft pastel stage pedestal (smooth porcelain white with subtle wood trim) sits under focused warm studio lighting. The focal point is a stylized golden butter block with a glossy/smooth texture sitting on a ceramic plate. When clicked, the butter compresses dynamically downward with squish deformation and golden crumb burst particles, paired with UI bounce on the crunch counter. The UI features a clean, rounded, high-contrast digital counter HUD centered at the top of the screen with clear typography and tactile scale pops on increment.",
  "assetStrategy": "Strictly adheres to user sourcing guidelines: audio assetNeed for crunch sound is marked required: true to be retrieved from Creator Store/Marketplace. Visual assetNeeds for butter model/mesh and dish/plate prop are queried on Marketplace with optional fallback to authored procedural butter model geometry if search inspection returns no suitable candidates. Counter UI, stage geometry, lighting, and animation tweening are authored directly.",
  "assetNeeds": [
    {
      "id": "crunchSound",
      "requirementId": "req-audio-crunch",
      "role": "Auditory crunch sound effect played upon squishing/crunching the butter block",
      "kind": "Audio",
      "query": "crunch squish food bite break",
      "constraints": "Crisp, snappy crunch or squish sound effect under 2 seconds, no speech, royalty-free Creator Store audio",
      "required": true,
      "position": [0, 3, 0],
      "maxSize": 12
    },
    {
      "id": "butterMesh",
      "requirementId": "req-butter-model",
      "role": "Visual 3D model or mesh of a butter block or butter stick",
      "kind": "Model",
      "query": "butter stick food block",
      "constraints": "Single clean food prop representing butter or butter block, under 6 studs in size",
      "required": false,
      "position": [0, 3, 0],
      "maxSize": 6
    }
  ],
  "requirements": [
    {
      "id": "req-stage-butter",
      "description": "Construct a clean, minimalist stage featuring a pedestal with a central butter object and comfortable player spawn position overlooking the butter.",
      "sourceQuote": "one butter object on a small clean stage",
      "origin": "user",
      "category": "world",
      "priority": "required",
      "acceptance": "A clean stage platform is present with a pedestal and a central butter object at the focal center, with a safe player spawn located nearby."
    },
    {
      "id": "req-butter-model",
      "description": "Provide a high quality butter visual, utilizing Marketplace assets where available with procedural fallback if no suitable mesh is found.",
      "sourceQuote": "one butter object on a small clean stage",
      "origin": "user",
      "category": "presentation",
      "priority": "required",
      "acceptance": "The butter object has distinct yellow/golden coloring, appropriate proportions, smooth styling, and rests stably atop the stage pedestal."
    },
    {
      "id": "req-crunch-interaction",
      "description": "Provide a repeatable click/tap interaction on desktop and mobile that triggers the crunch action on the butter object.",
      "sourceQuote": "one repeatable click/tap crunch interaction with visible animation and synchronized crunch sound",
      "origin": "user",
      "category": "mechanic",
      "priority": "required",
      "acceptance": "Clicking or tapping the butter object directly or pressing the action button initiates a crunch cycle."
    },
    {
      "id": "req-audio-crunch",
      "description": "Play a verified Marketplace crunch sound synchronized with the crunch animation upon every successful interaction.",
      "sourceQuote": "synchronized crunch sound... ALL AUDIO MUST COME FROM CREATOR STORE / MARKETPLACE",
      "origin": "user",
      "category": "audio",
      "priority": "required",
      "acceptance": "An audible Marketplace-sourced crunch sound plays at the butter position upon interaction initiation."
    },
    {
      "id": "req-crunch-animation-reset",
      "description": "Animate the butter squishing/flattening down upon crunch, followed by a smooth recovery/reset back to its original resting state.",
      "sourceQuote": "visible animation... Recover/reset the object after each action.",
      "origin": "user",
      "category": "animation",
      "priority": "required",
      "acceptance": "The butter visibly squashes/deforms when crunched and smoothly tweens back to its default shape and pose upon cycle completion."
    },
    {
      "id": "req-counter-logic",
      "description": "A counter starting at 0 that increments by exactly 1 per completed crunch, reading 10 after ten separated crunches, with debounce preventing overlapping double-counts.",
      "sourceQuote": "one readable counter. Counter starts at zero, increases exactly once per completed crunch, and reads 10 after ten separated crunches. Overlapping input must not double-count.",
      "origin": "user",
      "category": "mechanic",
      "priority": "required",
      "acceptance": "Counter starts at 0, increments by 1 per full crunch, reads 10 after 10 crunches, and spam clicks during active crunch are rejected."
    },
    {
      "id": "req-counter-ui",
      "description": "Display a clean, readable counter HUD at the top of the screen visible on both desktop and mobile devices.",
      "sourceQuote": "one readable counter... Support desktop and mobile controls.",
      "origin": "user",
      "category": "ui",
      "priority": "required",
      "acceptance": "A persistent HUD element shows 'Crunches: X' with high contrast, crisp text scaling, and smooth numerical updates across all screen sizes."
    },
    {
      "id": "req-cross-platform-support",
      "description": "Support both desktop mouse click interactions and mobile tap/touch inputs seamlessly.",
      "sourceQuote": "Support desktop and mobile controls. No shops, upgrades, economy, saving, monetization or unrelated gameplay.",
      "origin": "user",
      "category": "mechanic",
      "priority": "required",
      "acceptance": "Mouse clicks on desktop and touchscreen taps on mobile reliably trigger the butter crunch interaction."
    }
  ],
  "questions": [],
  "referenceDecisions": [
    {
      "mechanicId": "butter-crunch-core",
      "action": "include",
      "requirementIds": [
        "req-stage-butter",
        "req-crunch-interaction",
        "req-audio-crunch",
        "req-crunch-animation-reset",
        "req-counter-logic",
        "req-counter-ui"
      ],
      "reason": "Direct implementation of the requested single-stage butter crunching loop with debounce and counter."
    },
    {
      "mechanicId": "shop-monetization-exclusion",
      "action": "omit",
      "requirementIds": [],
      "reason": "Explicitly forbidden by user request: no shops, upgrades, economy, saving, monetization, or unrelated gameplay."
    }
  ],
  "tasks": [
    {
      "id": "task-world-setup",
      "title": "Build Stage, Pedestal, and Butter Object Hierarchy",
      "requirements": [
        "req-stage-butter",
        "req-butter-model"
      ],
      "dependsOn": [],
      "files": []
    },
    {
      "id": "task-core-network-config",
      "title": "Define Shared Butter Configuration and Remote Events",
      "requirements": [
        "req-crunch-interaction",
        "req-counter-logic"
      ],
      "dependsOn": [
        "task-world-setup"
      ],
      "files": [
        "ReplicatedStorage/Forge_93d16edb774b/ButterConfig.luau"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "task-server-gameplay",
      "title": "Implement Server Crunch Validation, Debounce, Audio Sound, and Counter State",
      "requirements": [
        "req-crunch-interaction",
        "req-counter-logic",
        "req-audio-crunch",
        "req-crunch-animation-reset"
      ],
      "dependsOn": [
        "task-core-network-config"
      ],
      "files": [
        "ServerScriptService/Forge_93d16edb774b/ButterServer.server.luau"
      ]
    },
    {
      "id": "task-client-interaction-hud",
      "title": "Implement Client Interaction, Butter Deformation Animation, Sound Sync, and Counter HUD",
      "requirements": [
        "req-crunch-interaction",
        "req-counter-ui",
        "req-crunch-animation-reset",
        "req-cross-platform-support"
      ],
      "dependsOn": [
        "task-server-gameplay"
      ],
      "files": [
        "StarterPlayer/StarterPlayerScripts/Forge_93d16edb774b/ButterClient.client.luau"
      ]
    }
  ]
}
